يجتليان (form VIII)
# يَجْتَلِيَانِ (yajtaliyāni) /jad͡ʒ.ta.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# يُجْتَلَيَانِ (yujtalayāni) /jud͡ʒ.ta.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
